description: MSN epsilon=1 admits the distance-2 shortcut of a chain
derivation: Hand-traced against AbstractMSN::computeMSN (relaxed, epsilon=1). Sequences AAAA, AAAT, AATT: distances H1-H2=1, H2-H3=1, H1-H3=2. Level 1 adds both unit edges (relaxed mode adds all pairs at the level); after merging, the graph is connected, so maxValue = 1 + 1 = 2. Level 2 (<= maxValue) adds H1-H3. Ids by sorted sequence: AAAA->H1, AAAT->H2, AATT->H3.
